title: 1996 AMC 8 Problem 13
statement: In the fall of \(1996,\) a total of \(800\) students participated in an annual school clean-up day. The organizers of the event expect that in each of the years \(1997,\) \(1998,\) and \(1999,\) participation will increase by \(50\%\) over the previous year. The number of participants the organizers expect in the fall of \(1999\) is

solutions.text:
Each year multiplies the count by \(1.5:\) \(800 \to 1200 \to 1800 \to 2700.\)

So \(800 \cdot 1.5^3 = 2700\) participants are expected in \(1999.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E .
hints: A \(50\%\) increase multiplies the number by \(1.5\)
Apply the factor \(1.5\) three times, for \(1997,\) \(1998,\) and \(1999\)
